structured_output.summary: Arizona taxes at a flat 2.5% starting from federal AGI of $61,592. HB 4168 (Laws 2026, ch. 140, signed 2026-06-13) set the single standard deduction at $15,750, retroactive to tax year 2025. It kept subsection H, which says the department "shall adjust" that amount for inflation in the same way the federal basic standard deduction is adjusted. Indexed that way, the 2026 deduction is $16,100, the federal amount the IRS published on 2025-10-09. That gives taxable income of $45,492 and tax of $1,137.30. The engine applied the unindexed 2025 amount of $15,750, which produced $1,146.05. That is an engine defect. Stage 1 and the 12-model consensus both reached $1,137.30.
structured_output.engine_step_at_issue: Arizona deductions of $15,750 subtracted from AGI $61,592.09 (standard deduction taken at the unindexed 2025 statutory amount rather than the 2026 inflation-adjusted amount required by A.R.S. 43-1041(H))
